claims: Carlos Boozer is a former NBA star.
Carlos Boozer has four children across two marriages.
Carlos Boozer's oldest son is Carmani Boozer.
Carlos Boozer has twins named Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer.
Carlos Boozer's youngest daughter is Bloom Boozer.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer are basketball players for Duke University.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were born in 2007.
Duke University is Carlos Boozer's alma mater.
Carmani Boozer was diagnosed with sickle cell disease at a young age.
Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer were born via IVF.
Doctors selected healthy embryos for Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer that were a genetic match to cure Carmani Boozer of sickle cell disease.
The cure for Carmani Boozer used stem cells from the umbilical cord of Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer.
Aneshka Smith is Carlos Boozer's second wife.
CeCe Boozer is the mother of Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer.
Carlos Boozer and CeCe Boozer are actively involved in supporting Cameron Boozer and Cayden Boozer's basketball careers, according to People.com.
